scientific_integrity: The Cauchy determinant and cyclotomic products are classical proof ingredients. Novelty is limited to the two-ring exact mixed-radius phase design, arithmetic phase law and its sharp stability. Finite computations are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Design restricted to two individually regular concentric polygons and the standard normalized disk Szego kernel; no claim of full two-circle Fekete optimality, condition-number optimality, or all-arrangement optimality. General sampling design paper full text unavailable; historical coverage cannot be exhaustively ruled out.
title: Sharp phase staggering for two concentric Szegő orbit designs
